public_command: Mount browser_check.py as /check.py:ro, public-evidence as /source:ro and this report folder as /out:rw; run python /check.py.
owner_command: Mount owner_check.py as /check.py:ro, this report folder as /out:rw, and the original project test owner storage state as /owner-session.json:ro; run python /check.py. Do not publish or print storage state.
supplement_command: Mount the script folder as /scripts:ro, report folder as /out:rw and original project test owner storage state as /owner-session.json:ro; run python -P /scripts/supplement.py. -P prevents the diagnostic inspect.py file from shadowing the Python stdlib inspect module.
request_policy: Only GET/HEAD may reach the public service. In the explicit mock context, POST /api/runs is locally fulfilled with synthetic 429 and never reaches the server.

evidence_interpretation.browser-attempt-1: Original About CSS zoom overflow, plus test-harness diff/regex errors; retained. Original owner instantaneous post-resize width also retained.
evidence_interpretation.browser-attempt-2: About layout fixed; one test regex remained incorrect. The original source catalog did not contain rendered download URLs, so download coverage was incomplete; not counted as 23 verified downloads.
evidence_interpretation.final: Current browser-check.json explicitly requires 23 distinct current/historical assets and verifies every SHA, plus rendered browser download. Owner layout waits for chart resize and two animation frames; records instant and stable widths separately.
evidence_interpretation.zoom: CSS zoom2 is a stress test. Separate 720CSS width/DPR2 approximates 1440 desktop at 200% reflow, not an actual browser toolbar zoom action.
